Here is my restaurant dashboard

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
data("rest_inspec")

```


First, I clean the data:
```{r}
inspections =
  rest_inspec |>
  mutate(
    boro = str_to_title(boro),
    score = as.numeric(score),
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  ) |>
  filter(
    boro %in% c("Manhattan", "Brooklyn", "Queens",
                "Bronx", "Staten Island"),
    !is.na(score),
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(inspection_date)) |>
  distinct(camis, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Number of Restaurants by Borough

```{r}
inspections |>
  count(boro) |>
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, n)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~boro,
    y = ~n,
    color = ~boro,
    type = "bar",
    colors = "viridis"
  )
```

### Inspection Scores by Borough

```{r}
inspections |>
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, score)) |>
  plot_ly(
    y = ~score,
    color = ~boro,
    type = "box",
    colors = "viridis"
  )
```
